issues.desc: CHK-002 gate signature (renderedLines: string[]) must handle both renderMemoryFreshnessPack (full 60-line) and renderMemoryFreshnessPackSummary (4-line summary) call sites — done-prepare.ts and done-closure.ts both use the summary variant. The context says to update the wiring oracle but does not enumerate which oracle regexes will break; the implementer must track two distinct rendered-output shapes through the same gate, which is a design-clarity gap not captured explicitly in the checklist context.

Background cites authority/gateEvidence at playbook-runtime-memory.ts:92-93/156/558/713 as a single-location cluster, but line 713 is `authority: non_authoritative` and line 714 is `gateEvidence: false`; the 714 line is omitted from the citation. Immaterial for implementation but the line-reference is off-by-one for the second field.

CHK-003 lists playbook_diff/playbook_activate-class read paths as commands to block but neither name appears in command-policy.ts under those exact identifiers. The smoke test will enumerate them, but the background-level claim should be verified against actual registered command names to avoid the implementer blocking phantom commands or missing real retrieval-surfacing commands.
